newsitem.title: FINLAND: UPM BUYS U.K. FORESTER FOR 6 MLN STG.
newsitem.headline: UPM BUYS U.K. FORESTER FOR 6 MLN STG.

text.p: Finnish forest industry group UPM-Kymmene Oy said in a statement on Friday it had together with its U.K. subsidiary Shotton Paper Company bought U.K. forester Tilhill Economic Forestry for six million sterling.
UPM-Kymmene and Shotton Paper bought Tilhill from U.K. food and agribusiness group Booker plc. .
"The biggest forest management company in Great Britain will be created by joining Shotton Paper's and TEF's forest management operations," UPM-Kymmene said.
The new company would maintain and administrate 180,000 hectares of forests, it said.
Shotton Paper managing director Kevin Lyden will be chairman of the new company and Tilhill's current managing direction will continue in his present position, it said.
